company.name: dcbel
company.shortDescription: Dcbel specializes in smart home energy systems that empower users to manage their energy supply through a single device.
company.description: Dcbel specializes in smart home energy systems that empower users to manage their energy supply through a single device.  The company utilizes AI and micro-weather forecasting to optimize energy use and prepare for outages by storing energy during off-peak times. Dcbel is also focusing on bidirectional DC fast charging for homes, allowing users to power their electric vehicles more efficiently.

productsAndServices.description: A home energy station that connects to a bidirectional EV or home battery to provide backup power, energy management, DC EV charging, and participation in energy programs.

productsAndServices.description: A residential energy-system design and deployment service that configures Ara equipment with solar panels, home batteries, EVs, and the utility grid for automated energy control and backup power.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $2,466,148, representing 1.67% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $38,282,108 to $674,110,677, a 17.61x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
